lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, following a semi-regular grid distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity running perpendicular to the longitudinal axis, forming anchor nodes at the intersection with horizontal rows of circular blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges visible along the dorsal-lateral surface, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light highlights above to dark shadows below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark elongated silhouettes attached to the ventral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
